titel: The Frog That Hides Its Blood

beats.say: This frog can make its blood... *vanish.*
The red disappears, and the frog turns almost *invisible!*
Meet the *glass frog*, about the size of a marshmallow.
From below, you can watch its *heart* beating.
By day, it sleeps upside down under a *leaf.*
But bright red blood would give it *away.*
So as it falls asleep, it packs its red blood cells into its *liver.*
That makes it up to *three times* more see-through.
And somehow, all that packed blood never *clots.*
So next time you look under a leaf, look closer... because
